verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance documents OAuth client-credentials for server-to-server use, which an agent could use. Secrets are shown once and can be rotated. Write capabilities (create/update/delete) must be explicitly granted to the account by Harbor Compliance, giving a read-only-by-default privilege posture. However, this gating is account-level and vendor-granted; there is no evidence that users can issue per-credential scopes themselves. missing for 10: user-issued per-credential OAuth scopes or permission selection, multiple scoped credentials per account, agent-specific credential guidance, independent corroboration.
